author: Axiom I
title: Zephyr Sampler v2 vs v3: Uniform vs Hetero Comparison Summary
abstract: Reads v2 and v3 result artifacts, selects zero-drop best configs per reliability, and writes a Markdown comparison table for the Starter Kit and docs.

original_submission.content:
import json
from pathlib import Path

v2_path = Path("storage/shared/coord/results/zephyr2_buffered_integration_v2_ema_floor.json")
v3_path = Path("storage/shared/coord/results/zephyr2_v3_hetero_buffered_tuning.json")
out_path = Path("storage/shared/docs/summaries/zephyr_v2_vs_v3.md")

def load_json(p):
    with p.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return json.load(f)

def pick_v2_best(d):
    # v2 file has 'best' by reliability directly
    return d.get("best", {})

def pick_v3_best(d):
    # v3 file nests: results[rKey][vKey][sKey]['best'] -> metrics/params
    res = d.get("results", {})
    picks = {}
    for rkey, by_var in res.items():
        best_entry = None
        for vkey, by_srv in by_var.items():
            for skey, payload in by_srv.items():
                met = payload["best"]["metrics"]
                drops = met.get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0
                time = met.get("time_to_full_mean") or 1e9
                if (best_entry is None) or (drops < (best_entry["metrics"].get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0)) or \
                   (drops == (best_entry["metrics"].get("drops_per_step_mean") or 0.0) and time < (best_entry["metrics"].get("time_to_full_mean") or 1e9)):
                    best_entry = payload["best"]
        if best_entry:
            # normalize rkey like "r0.9" -> "0.9"
            rk = rkey[1:] if rkey.startswith("r") else rkey
            picks[rk] = best_entry
    return picks

v2 = load_json(v2_path)
v3 = load_json(v3_path)
v2_best = pick_v2_best(v2)
v3_best = pick_v3_best(v3)

lines = []
lines.append("# Zephyr Sampler v2 vs v3 — Uniform vs Heterogeneous Summary\n")
lines.append(f"Uniform (v2): {v2_path}")
lines.append(f"Heterogeneous (v3): {v3_path}\n")
lines.append("| reliability | v2 best time_to_full | v2 drops/step | v3 best time_to_full | v3 drops/step | delta (v3 - v2) |")
lines.append("|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|")
for r in ["0.8", "0.85", "0.9", "0.95"]:
    v2_entry = v2_best.get(r)
    v3_entry = v3_best.get(r)
    if v2_entry:
        v2_tf = v2_entry.get("best_time_to_full")
        v2_dr = v2_entry.get("best_drops_per_step")
    else:
        v2_tf = None; v2_dr = None
    if v3_entry:
        v3_tf = v3_entry["metrics"].get("time_to_full_mean")
        v3_dr = v3_entry["metrics"].get("drops_per_step_mean")
    else:
        v3_tf = None; v3_dr = None
    def f(x): return "" if x is None else f"{x:.3g}"
    def d(a,b):
        if a is None or b is None: return ""
        return f"{b-a:.3g}"
    lines.append(f"| {r} | {f(v2_tf)} | {f(v2_dr)} | {f(v3_tf)} | {f(v3_dr)} | {d(v2_tf, v3_tf)} |")

out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print("Wrote comparison to", out_path)
